segments: And at the beginning of his reign, Hirom (Hiram) became king over Tyre,
who sent to Solomon, to help in the building of the Temple, eighty thousand men.
And according to some,
Homer and Hesiod became known at this time.
Solomon uprooted Antioch,
and built seven cities:
Palmyra, which is Tadmor;
Millo;
Hazor;
Megiddo;
Gezer;
Lower Beth-horon;
Baalath.
And from the Exodus from Egypt until the building of the Temple were six hundred and thirty-four years.
And in other copies, six hundred and ten.
And in the Book of Kings, four hundred and eighty is written,
omitting the years of the rule of the adversaries.
And so also the Apostle Paul says:
"For four hundred and fifty years He gave them judges until Samuel."
And from Adam until the building of the Temple were four thousand one hundred and sixty-eight [years].
After Solomon, Rehoboam his son reigned in Jerusalem over Judah for seventeen years.
And at the beginning of his reign, Jeroboam reigned in Tirzah over Israel for twenty-two years.
And he made two golden calves:
one in Dan,
and one in Bethel.
And he said:
"Behold your gods,
O Israel,
who brought you up from the land of Egypt!"
And Shemaiah {OCR?} the prophet came from Judah,
and rebuked him for his sin which he sinned and caused Israel to sin.
And he prophesied and said:
"O altar, altar,
hear the word of the Lord!
Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name;
and he shall sacrifice the pagan priests upon you,
and men's bones shall be burned upon you."
And at this, Jeroboam stretched out his hand to kill him,
and it withered.
And when he begged him,
he prayed and it was healed.
And Epiphanius said
that the name of this prophet was Jehoiada from Samaria.
And it was he whom a lion killed,
because he listened to the old prophet who deceived him {OCR?},
and he ate bread and transgressed the commandment.
And that one had taken a garment and torn it into twelve [pieces],
and given ten to Jeroboam.
And in the fifth year of Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem through the treachery of Jeroboam,
and he took the golden shields which Solomon had made.
Then Rehoboam made [shields] of bronze in their place.
After Rehoboam, Abijah his son reigned for three years.
